newsitem.title: ITALY: MAX RATE 6.92 PCT AT BANK OF ITALY BOT SALE.
newsitem.headline: MAX RATE 6.92 PCT AT BANK OF ITALY BOT SALE.

text.p: The maximum rate at today's Bank of Italy sale of 2.0 trillion lire of short-term Treasury bills (BOT) stood at 6.92 percent.
The average rate was 6.88 percent. The offer, which was fully taken up, takes effect today.
The Bank said it received 16 bids of which three were met in full and one in part.
The last BOT sale was on December 13 when the Bank of Italy sold 3.75 trillion lire of paper at a maximum rate of 7.59 percent and average rate of 7.51 percent.
